game_title: Divide Or Floor – Fire Shrine Trial
game_concept: A puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Fire Shrine, an ancient fire shrine: the ash ranger must handle cinder bats while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Divide Or Floor: Pick / or // to split heat shields evenly among allies without leaving fractions.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Fire Shrine: an ancient fire shrine
core_gameplay_loop: In Fire Shrine, repeat each round: Pick / or // to split heat shields evenly among allies without leaving fractions. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the share value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the obsidian gate using at most 20 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The obsidian gate reached with actions_used <= 20.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 20 before the obsidian gate is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 5 (applied tier): Divide Or Floor
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Divide Or Floor' (Week 2 slot 4), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Fire Shrine'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how share changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cinder bats in Fire Shrine.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The obsidian gate reached with actions_used <= 20.
